notes.title: The House of Da Vinci 3 is coming to Steam this fall
notes.content:
We have some good news for those of you patiently waiting for the next installment of The House of Da Vinci. The development is well on its way, and we expect that it will be available on Steam store in the Fall of 2022. Read the details, check out the screenshots and add the game to your Wishlist so you do not miss the release!

👉 Add the game to your wishlist now: bit.ly/HDV-3


The grand finale to The House of Da Vinci trilogy is coming! Expect a great many new puzzles, a thrilling story, and the same (or even better) high quality that everybody came to love in our previous games.

[h2]THE STORY[/h2]

The time has finally come: become Giacomo one last time and join Leonardo da Vinci, the master of both art and science, as his friend and apprentice. Explore more of the Renaissance world full of puzzles, discover secret messages, and reveal mechanical wonders. Unravel conspiracies involving the most powerful people in Italy – and travel not only through space but time as well. Meet friends and rivals both old and new. Become the focus of a plan that might change history forever.

With sharp wits and an open mind, you will prevail.

[h2]KEY FEATURES[/h2]

[b]NEW ADVENTURE, NEW PUZZLES[/b]
Enjoy original new puzzles, and examine concealed objects and mechanisms to find out what makes them tick.

[b]USE THE PAST TO YOUR ADVANTAGE[/b]
Use the mysterious Oculus Perpetua to change the past, influencing your surroundings in the present and allowing you to solve the otherwise unsolvable.

[b]NEW AND IMPROVED INTERACTIONS[/b]
Find new ways to interact with the beautiful, handcrafted world around you. Control Giacomo's actions even more intuitively than ever before.

[b]VARIED LOCATIONS[/b]
Explore breathtaking new locations in Italy and beyond. Search them for clues and travel both in time and space.

[b]EPIC FINALE[/b]
Listen to fully voiced historical figures, watch epic cut scenes, and discover how the story of Giacomo concludes its final stage.

notes.title: 1.0.1 Update now Live!
notes.content:
Based on your feedback, we’ve made several gameplay optimizations, bug fixes and improvements, such as:
• Added mouse invert possibility
• Fixed Astrolab bug in the Tower chapter
• Several minor optimizations to make your experience better

Thanks for playing and reviewing the game. Don’t forget to spread the word about the game!
